# scripts/filelength_check.py, run by scripts/tidy.sh, fails on a file past 1,000
# lines that isn't listed, on a listed file longer than its number and on a line
# that no longer applies, so the list and its numbers only shrink: a split lowers
# or removes its line (scripts/tidy.sh --update-size-baseline), and a line is
# added by hand only. Exempt: data tables, generated files, core/include/ecuio/
# (the public headers) and third_party/.
